scope: Next.js src runtime compatibility with RiftCoach v0.7 data package

blockers.title: items.json root shape mismatch
evidence: data.zip items.json is object wrapper with meta/items
blockers.impact: Items page may throw list.filter is not a function.
blockers.required_fix: Generate public/data/items.json as root array compatibility view. Store wrapped canonical data elsewhere.

blockers.title: runes.json slot/effect mismatch
evidence: src/app/runes/page.tsx groups by string slots keystone/primary_1/...
data.zip runes.json slot is numeric and effect is absent
blockers.impact: Runes page can render no rune groups or omit descriptions.
blockers.required_fix: Generate UI slot strings and effect aliases in public/data/runes.json.

blockers.title: builds.json missing id and uses display names instead of IDs
evidence: src/app/builds/page.tsx key uses b.id and lookup maps by item/rune/spell id
data.zip builds.json has no id and uses names in item/rune/spell arrays
blockers.impact: Build filtering/icon resolution can degrade or fail.
blockers.required_fix: Generate stable build IDs and normalized reference IDs.

blockers.title: wr_items.json referenced but absent
blockers.impact: Build engine loses richer item metadata.

blockers.title: Karma correction compatibility issue
evidence: data.zip wr_champions_corrections.json exposes champions_to_add, not champions
blockers.impact: Corrections can be ignored; protected Karma ability lock can regress.
blockers.required_fix: Emit compatible corrections.champions or patch loader to read both champions and champions_to_add.

blockers.title: /api/draft route contract mismatch
blockers.impact: Draft AI advice can fail regardless of data quality.
blockers.required_fix: Patch frontend payload or route input contract.

blockers.title: BuildView structured path unreachable
evidence: src/app/coach/page.tsx renders BuildView only if API response JSON has type build
src/app/api/chat/route.ts streams markdown and does not return type build JSON
blockers.impact: Structured build UI and /api/reasoning may not activate.
blockers.required_fix: Choose markdown-only or structured JSON Route A and align code.

blockers.title: Role alias drift
evidence: relationship-engine loads wr_matchups_${roleId}.json and current files use adc
blockers.impact: Duo/Dragon role lookups can miss relationship files.
blockers.required_fix: Add role aliases and/or duplicate duo compatibility files.

hard_gates_before_runtime_replace: public/data/runes.json UI slot strings and effect aliases
public/data/builds.json stable IDs and normalized references
Karma ability lock passes across canonical and public views
Source-verified exact fields have field-level provenance
